strings.zh: 咦？你打败了外面的暴走族吗？{SCROLL}因为最近暴走族阻止客人{NEWLINE}进我们店买车,{CLEAR}所以生意都不太好。{CLEAR}谢谢你帮忙教训暴走族,{CLEAR}作为谢礼请在我们店挑一辆自行车……
strings.en: Huh? Did you beat the bikers outside?{SCROLL}Lately the bikers have been stopping{NEWLINE}customers from coming in to buy bikes,{CLEAR}so business has been slow. Thanks for{CLEAR}teaching them a lesson. As thanks,{CLEAR}please pick out any bike in our shop...

strings.zh: 啊……你已经有自行车了啊。{NEWLINE}这样的话请你收下这个吧。
strings.en: Oh... You already have a Bicycle. In{NEWLINE}that case, please take this instead.

strings.zh: 这是满金市车站的列车票,{NEWLINE}你想坐列车的话{CLEAR}用这个票随时都可以去坐。
strings.en: It’s a Magnet Train Pass for Goldenrod{NEWLINE}Station. Whenever you want to{CLEAR}ride the train, just use this pass.

strings.zh: 本公司的总店设在{NEWLINE}关东的华蓝市。{SCROLL}听说那边因为有专门的自行车道,{NEWLINE}自行车的销量比城都地区要好很多呢。
strings.en: Our company’s main store is{NEWLINE}in Cerulean City, in Kanto.{SCROLL}I hear they have special bike{NEWLINE}paths over there, so bikes sell a{CLEAR}lot better than they do in Johto.

strings.zh: 哈……{NEWLINE}想被人温柔地对待啊。
strings.en: Sigh... Oh, for the kindness{NEWLINE}of people...
